findings.title: Selecting a portrait automatically supplies adult/community consent
reproduction: From email verification enter Complete public introduction 10:236.
Its only forward reaction is portrait 10:272 → 10:375.
Ready screen shows checked 18+/community label; Take your seat goes directly to 11:753.
findings.observed: 10:359 and 10:500 consent labels have no reaction. Portrait transition supplies description and prechecked consent; user never explicitly agrees. Screenshot 10:375 shows the check.
findings.expected: Filling/selecting an identity sample must preserve unchecked adult/community consent. Only explicit consent enables completion.
findings.closureCondition: Separate a visible populated-but-unchecked state from explicit-consent checked state, wire toggle/cancel, verify no route to application from portrait alone.
findings.method: actual native reaction/text readback and listed rendered screenshots; not claimed Presentation clicks

findings.title: Optional analytics cannot be changed, and saved settings is a dead end
reproduction: Optional analytics switch has no reaction.
Save privacy choice goes directly to saved-Off 12:882.
findings.observed: Saved-Off frame has zero descendant reactions, including visible Back. No draft On/Off → Save/Cancel representative route; returning or continuing is impossible in graph.
findings.expected: Show distinct editable draft and saved value; explicit Save persists representative choice, cancellation returns previous confirmed state, saved page remains navigable.
findings.closureCondition: Wire one meaningful On/Off draft + Save/Back/Cancel roundtrip with correct confirmed value on reentry; graph/screenshot check plus Presentation when accessible.
findings.method: actual native reaction/text readback and listed rendered screenshots; not claimed Presentation clicks

findings.title: Saving blank preference example introduces two unconfirmed fields
reproduction: Open My preferences: No saved preferences yet.
Textarea displays source placeholder Soho, budget £35, table for 4, English and has no input reaction.
findings.observed: Save jumps directly to saved six-field summary including Vegetarian options and Easy conversation, absent from visible proposal. No pending parsed six-field confirmation exists. Screenshot initial and saved states corroborate.
findings.expected: Natural-language input must produce a visible pending proposal of allowed fields and explicit user confirmation; no unstated dietary/mood values may be remembered.
findings.closureCondition: Show the exact six-field proposal before Save/Confirm, with meaningful input sample/confirmation transition; no new field after confirmation and delete/Keep returns correct confirmed state.
findings.method: actual native reaction/text readback and listed rendered screenshots; not claimed Presentation clicks

findings.title: Main authentication/application recovery controls are inert
reproduction: Enter returning login → email and try Back in sign-in.
On arrangement-confirmed application try Go back.
On Pending try Go back or Track in Inbox.
findings.observed: These visible controls have no reactions. Google/Apple buttons likewise have no reactions; provider-owned real screens may be specified-only, but representative cancel and return routes are not executable.
findings.expected: Necessary Back/cancel and post-success history return must preserve original meal and state; optional system provider UI may stay a specified contract without pretending it was tested.
findings.closureCondition: Wire Back in returning login/email, checked application Back, Pending Back/Inbox to valid same-state destination; clearly classify provider system boundary, do not claim its clicks passed.
findings.method: actual native reaction/text readback and listed rendered screenshots; not claimed Presentation clicks

findings.title: AI transfer silently drops a sentence from an in-range draft
findings.observed: Candidate ends Is there anything I should know before joining?; both transferred variants omit that sentence though candidate is below 300 characters. No explicit edit/summarize action explains the change.
findings.expected: Transfer preserves candidate verbatim; if target limit exceeded, require shortening rather than silent truncation.
findings.closureCondition: Read back exact equality of candidate and transferred editor sample; Keep preserves manual text, replacement stays unchecked until consent, Send remains independent.
findings.method: actual native reaction/text readback and listed rendered screenshots; not claimed Presentation clicks

findings.title: First permission page already displays a completed AI response
reproduction: From public meal detail click Ask Fancy.
Arrive at first Assistant data permission before Allow and continue.
findings.observed: Permission frame already contains a user request Find a meal for Friday in Soho, any budget and Fancy No available tables response. The graph requires no prior Allow or Send to reach this generated-result state.
findings.expected: Before permission and explicit request, show disclosure/manual alternative and no fabricated completed assistant turn. Provider/legal facts can remain a configuration gate for real calls; no invented provider details required here.
findings.closureCondition: Remove/fence preconsent result/history from this first-use route; Allow alone should not imply a new user request. Demonstrate permitted explicit Send → sample response/draft and refusal → manual original meal.
findings.method: actual native reaction/text readback and listed rendered screenshots; not claimed Presentation clicks
